reviews.text: Really happy with Bimba Doggy Salon! We brought Miso, a 13-year-old miniature poodle we were looking after, and they were so sweet and gentle with him. They took extra care around his sensitive spots, especially his mouth and ears. Lovely to see how patient they are with older dogs. We’ll definitely be back!
So sweet and nice! Mr Jansen was very happy and pretty after the treatment 🐶🐕

Took our miniature poodle puppy Kai here and couldn't be happier. He came out looking great and was clearly relaxed and well looked after the whole time. The team was super responsive and helpful from booking to pickup, and it's obvious they really care about the dogs. We'll definitely be back!
Thank you! 💚 …

We brought our 12-week-old puppy here for a puppy groom. They handle the dogs very professionally, lovingly, and with care. Our puppy looked beautiful again afterwards and visibly enjoyed herself. Highly recommended!

A wonderful salon.

They do a magnificent job and are great people. The care they put into their work is exquisite. I have three dogs who go at least once a month!

Without a doubt, my favorite place for them. 🤞🏽
Took my Ziggy for a wash for the first time and he loved it! Maika is really good with making doggies feel at ease, definitely coming back🐶
❤️ happy dog super spa day

Top service. The girls are friendly, caring and attentive to details. My doodle is not easy to deal with due to anxiety during grooming, but they managed to calm her down and give me back the most beautiful and happy dog!
Did an amazing job!

Maika is an excellent groomer and always styles my mini Bernedoodle exactly how I want. The length and cut are consistently perfect, and she does a great job listening to my preferences. My dog is usually very nervous with groomers, but he’s always calm and comfortable with Maika, which says a lot. I would highly recommend her!
Our 5-month-old Labradoodle had his first grooming session and we are very happy with the result. Especially that he came back very relaxed and happy.
our waterdog needed a lot of grooming to get his coat off and they patiently worked at him. wonderful price for that amount of work! will be returning!
Marli (Australian Labradoodle) smelled wonderful and looked tip-top! So much attention and love for the dog with fantastic service. We have already booked again.

Visited for the first time with our 4-month-old Golden Retriever for a puppy groom and are really super satisfied! 👌🏻 So nice that this option is available for socialization.

Our pup felt completely at ease and everything went great. I couldn't have wished for a nicer first experience! 5/5 for the experience and we will definitely be back.

Maika is a fantastic groomer, lovely person and so patient. She took the time to make my dog really comfortable since he was a new client and normally anxious at the groomers and with new people. He left Bimba’s very calm and relaxed after his nap in the spa cabin ;) and looking fantastic with his fresh cut! 5 star experience all around! Also love the online booking system!
It was great! Second time and we are super happy
Quiet dog salon, Chippie got all the attention. He doesn't like the hairdresser, but came out very relaxed. He looked very nicely groomed.
Spotty was very relaxed and felt at home at Bimba's. He came out looking spick and span and ready for new adventures

I’m so happy I found you. You helped me find a suitable solution for my old dog Joy, and I really appreciate the care and kindness you showed us. It’s comforting to know there are people like you who go the extra mile for animals and their owners. Thank you so much! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Absolutely fantastic! Very nicely cut, hair styled, and nails trimmed.
Top salon!
Really nice shop, my dog was so relaxed that she fell asleep there.

My dog ​​Noa and I are overjoyed that we found Maika.

What a fantastic groomer she is.
My very anxious dog had a wonderful experience there. So loving and calm that she even went to sleep in a basket there afterwards. And not unimportant: she cut her so beautifully. Truly top-notch. She has never looked this beautiful. Many thanks and see you soon!
Super friendly and sweet to our puppy Guus. He looks great again. We will definitely come back here!
Snoopy loves going to Bimba’s and getting a groom. Malia takes really good care of him!

This was the first time I took Bella to Bimba's and I am very satisfied with the result! They listen carefully to what you want for your dog, and Bella was all neat and clean again. I have noticed that it is difficult to make an appointment at short notice with groomers. Many grooming salons have a stop or a waiting list, but at Bimba's I was able to get an appointment the same week and could make an appointment online very easily. And then you even get a reminder that you have an appointment. Great!
Super nice salon, amazing service and well groomed dog! Highly recommend!
Wonderful service from a lovely owner too. Would definitely recommend! ❤️
Very satisfied, beautiful clean salon, lovely woman for the dogs. Will definitely bring them again next time. The dogs really enjoyed it, look good, and smell wonderful.

I have a large dog that is not a fan of being groomed. When I dropped him off he was a bit nervous but when I returned to pick him up he greeted me like he owned the place. Happy and relaxed and looking and smelling great. Bimba’s is worth the five stars!
Juniper has been there twice now and she comes back cuter every time! Highly recommend for dogs that can be scared of grooming, she loves it at Bimba’s🫶 …

Maika was so lovely and vey professional! She speaks both spanish and English which was great for me. I immediately felt comfortable leaving my doggie there while I went to the park. It was a great experience overal. I really recommend her!
Very nice and very caring! My dog received a beautiful haircut and felt very calm afterwards. We will be coming back!

Thanks to Baukje, who always faithfully comes to get and drink coffee at Karel’s coffee kiosk, I visited Bimba’s doggy salon today.

Simba was pampered, washed, trimmed, and treated to a true spa. He thought it was really chill, because otherwise he spaces out. After the session, for which Maika had set aside three hours, I was able to pick him up. She treated him with love. Very beautiful and nice and short for this excessive heat. Thank you. Muchas gracias 🙏🏼
Amazing groomer! She is very thorough and sweet to my Pomeranian.

I actually never write reviews, but what a fantastic place! My dog ​​is a somewhat difficult dachshund and we had previously been turned down by another salon. Luckily for us, because we had a wonderful experience here. The salon is super clean and Maika handled my dog ​​fantastically. No hassle, lots of patience, and a beautiful result. This will definitely be our new go-to salon!

We had an amazing experience with the grooming of our Maltipoo! Maika was patient, gentle, and clearly experienced with dogs. The grooming result was beautiful and exactly what we were hoping for. He looked fantastic, and it was clear that a lot of care and attention went into his groom.
Did a really nice job cutting my dog's hair!

I moved to a different neighborhood and needed to find a new place to have my little dog groomed. I am so happy that I chose this place because the owner is chill and friendly and obviously cares about dogs so much. My dog, who is always a little bit afraid of the groomer or the veterinarian, was not stressed when I brought him in in the first place and also did not try to pull me out the front door when I picked him up. He was happy to hang out and wag his tail and chill while I paid for the grooming and that is a very very good sign. Highly recommended to anyone

I’m absolutely thrilled with the service! My Pomeranian is always washed and groomed to perfection. His coat looks amazing afterward and feels incredibly soft. What I especially love is how wonderful he smells after every visit—so fresh and clean! You can really tell that they work with care, attention, and experience. I always feel confident leaving my dog here and keep coming back. Highly recommended! 🐾✨ thank you so much Maika greetings Helena & Kyla

I would highly recommend taking your dog to Bimba’s Doggy Salon! My dog Ben is usually quite nervous when it comes to grooming. Maika took her time with him. The salon is beautiful and very clean. Ben came back looking fantastic and relaxed. We’ll definitely be back in a few months! 🙂 …
Lovely lady and very sweet to my dog, she did a great job, will be back for sure!!
Super professional and kind doggy salon. Really taking care of the overall wellbeing of our girl. And she looks amazing!!!
My dog ​​Mochi, a 1.6-year-old Shiba Inu, loved it. Top service from Maika!
First time for Tudor (cockapoo) for a little wash and face trim. Maika was super welcoming, Tudor loved the treats and it went super well!

I took my Benny to this salon and had a really great experience. The staff were friendly, patient, and clearly knew how to handle dogs with care. Benny can be a bit nervous, but they made him feel comfortable right away.

The grooming was done beautifully, he came out looking clean, well-groomed, and very happy. I also appreciated that they took the time to listen to what I wanted and gave helpful suggestions.

Overall, great service, professional team, and I’ll definitely be coming back with Benny again.
Great grooming and even more amazing treatment! My puppy felt very comfortable and calm for his first grooming!

My dog ​​was treated very well and professionally! After the grooming, Nicky, my dog, could immediately go back into the mud in the park. Coat nice and short, no more tangles, and still a cute face. Maika is skilled and a very nice person. We will be back!
AMAZING! Dachi and I are super happy with Bimba’s services! Our Akita smells wonderful and shines brightly. The owner knows what she is doing and is very friendly. Regards

What an amazing service !!!! Professional, friendly, with the best vibe and above all, they made Oreo feel like family! Maika, you left Oreo beautiful and happy ;) thank you … see you in a few months with little salchichón ;) mil gracias ;)

I'm very satisfied and highly recommend them—the staff is amazing and experienced, and she's absolutely thrilled with her new look 🤭!
Thank you so much …
We are very happy we found Bimba’s! Just around the corner and perfect service from Maika. Our Billie did not want to leave, that is always the best possible review!
True artist at work
Very happy with the results! My dog is summer ready again.
Really happy with our pup’s first groom. Maika was really patient with him and offered lots of treats to get him comfortable. 🐶💕 …

Maika is wonderful! She took such good care of our dog Lana during her grooming session. The cut looks great, and Lana came home smelling fresh and looking tidy after her wash and nail trim. Highly recommendable!
Our Lio loves going to Bimba’s! 🫶🏼 Maika takes really good care of him and makes him look fresh and handsome. Thank you Maika!🙏🏻✨ …
Very happy with the service! Isla looks adorable. She was incredibly caring and did her best to honor my request to avoid cutting her hair too short, even though my dog had a lot of tangles.

My first time with my dog, Amy
And I’m so happy I found that place
Very professional owner, friendly with a big smile.
And great professional work .
My dog was groomed very professionally by my wishes.
Sure, I’ll be back again
Very good groomer. We were a bit anxious for our first appointment with a 5 month old puppy but the service was great and stressless for our pup !
Our Labradoodle went to a grooming salon for the first time. He received excellent care and the end result is beautiful!

The salon is super clean and new with all top notch equipment. My dog could be anxious but she was leaving the salon as a gorgeous and confident doggy. I am very grateful for the professional and lovely care! Very recommended! Also the products being used are professional and unique. The best thing that you can book online!
Really happy with the service! They treat your puppy really well and take good care of their wellbeing 🙏🏼 …
Amazing experience and lovely owner. Really good with the dog, good communication and service.
Great place and the best part is my doggie really liked it to be there. Easy to park too love G and Marley
Excellent dog salon, I got the best service from maika (the groomer) explaining step by step how she’d take care of my doggy. She did an awesome job and we left more than happy 10/10
Great results from Irish Terrier plucking session, will definitely be coming more!
Amazing service. Thank you!!
Amazing service! Our Maltipoo really enjoyed his first ever grooming!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
We are so happy with the care Canela de Maika received at Bimba’s Doggy Salon! It was her first time, and she left relaxed, happy, and fearless. She looked absolutely gorgeous, very well cared for, smelled wonderful, and her coat was incredibly soft.

We highly recommend it to all dog lovers. We'll definitely be back! 🐾✨🐶
Perfect trim and service. My dog and me loved the place!
Great location and service! My dog came back looking great!
Maika and Ali were wonderful and took amazing care of Charlie. His groom looks perfect and he’s fluffier than ever. Very happy with the result, would highly recommend the salon.
I'm very happy with Maika's service; it was very professional and the haircut was impeccable. I'll definitely be back; from now on, this will be my go-to salon. Thank you so much!
We groomed and sheded our American Akita! Was really great service and our dog was super happy!

Very satisfied with the grooming of my dog! She is a Pomeranian and Bimba's showed that they can cut Pomeranians into a beautiful shape. Her coat was super soft too, and she was happy when I came to pick her up. The staff is very nice as well, highly recommended!
Fantastic! A wonderful grooming salon. Both our dogs were beautifully groomed, we'll definitely be back ♡
Maika is super nice and sweet and she cuts my Doodle beautifully.. she really gives your four-legged friend a wonderful spa.. neat, well-maintained salon in Amsterdam👌 …

Our Australian Labradoodle Vesper isn't the biggest fan of grooming salons, but with Maika, she always feels immediately at ease. She knows exactly how to get Vesper calm and relaxed, and that is truly priceless.

Every time, Vesper comes back beautifully groomed, perfectly styled, soft, and so beautifully cared for—and this time with a very cute pink Christmas bandana around her neck.
You can tell from everything that she is treated with such kindness and that the work takes place in a beautiful, professional salon using top-quality materials and with a passion for the craft.

We are incredibly happy with her craftsmanship and her warm approach. Highly recommended!
Very satisfied! A great salon to have your dog groomed 🐶 …

We are so happy with Maika! Since she started her own salon, Bimba’s Doggy Salon, we have entrusted our Labradoodle, Doeby, to her for grooming with complete peace of mind. Every time, he looks fantastic and clearly feels at ease with her. It is a bit of an extra drive for us, but it is more than worth it. Craftsmanship, love for dogs, and a beautiful result – everything is just right. We highly recommend Maika and Bimba’s Doggy Salon!
The owner of this salon was very patient, kind and skilled with my slightly nervous dog. Definitely recommend this salon!
Maika is super nice and very professional. My dog ​​and I felt at ease immediately. Her salon is brand new. I am very happy with the result and have already scheduled a next appointment.

It’s been a struggle for me to give Mellow a nice bath.. she does t like wet paws..  luckily she LOVED THE expierence with Bimba’s Doggy Salon. And she smells amazing! And now she always wants to go for a bath… Thank you a lot!

Maika at Bimba's Doggy Salon was amazing! She made Cali feel so welcome with lots of care and treats. Cali looked and smelled fantastic after her groom. Super convenient location and a lovely experience — we’ll definitely be back!

Everything perfect! What wonderful service, the contact beforehand, the treatment, and the aftercare. Jackie looks beautiful! And bringing along that goodie bag was so sweet too. It was also great fun speaking Spanish with Maika! Truly a top-notch salon!!!!!! Gracias

Fons had a wonderfully relaxed time during his grooming session; even in the wellness cabin it was a party. They worked on him for 3.5 hours and he has a top-notch haircut again. And afterwards, a goodie bag with sweets and such 🐕🐩🐕‍🦺🐶 …
